name: Whitespace interrupting property/method chaining
description: Flags a space or tab immediately before or after a member/method access.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a space or tab immediately before or after a `.` member/method access (e.g. `SomeProperty . DoThing()`), since it interrupts the chain for no benefit. A `.` inside a `Float` literal (e.g. `1.5`) is never flagged. The fix closes the gap on whichever side(s) have it, without reaching across a newline (a chain continued onto another physical line is left alone).
